notes.title: Accidental Error
notes.notes:
We have just now posted an update that takes the game to version 1.5.

Due to an accidental error by us, the game files were reverted to version 0.1 when the game was launched. This update fixes this and properly updates the game to the latest version of 1.5.

This includes all content, gallery images and achievements.

All now fully functional. Apologies to all players who found the game was missing more than a little bit of content when they tried to play it since it released.
